description: The bar chart illustrates the number of morphosyntactic probing tasks evaluated for various language families within multilingual BERT models, as presented in the paper “Morphosyntactic probing of multilingual BERT models.” The horizontal axis, labeled “# tasks,” ranges from 0 to 80 in increments of 10, representing the count of probing tasks per language family. The vertical axis lists language families in descending order of task count: IE-Slavic (light blue, ~75 tasks), IE-Romance (dark blue, ~70 tasks), IE-Germanic (green, ~45 tasks), Uralic (pink, ~25 tasks), IE-Baltic (red, ~20 tasks), IE-other (orange, ~15 tasks), IE-Indic (brown, ~12 tasks), Semitic (light purple, ~8 tasks), Turkic (purple, ~5 tasks), and Basque (dark purple, ~3 tasks). Each bar is color-coded and corresponds to a specific language family, with IE-Slavic having the highest number of tasks and Basque the lowest. The bars are arranged in descending order from top to bottom, visually emphasizing the disparity in task coverage across language families. No error bars or additional annotations are present, and the chart uses a clean, minimalist design with diagonal gridlines to aid in value estimation.
